tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Sidebar background behind every answer. Never place text directly on it except the page chrome.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The answer surface (AnswerPanel). Everything else sits flush on it: no cards inside.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Fill of the question bubble, tooltips and quiet round buttons at rest.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Baselines, axes, timeline rails and empty containers (a jar, a room). Decorative only; never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, figures and selected labels, on raised and bubble. Also the playhead and scrubber knob.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Captions, units and secondary text on raised and bubble (at least 5.7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-mute
tokens.usage: Axis labels, kickers and resting legend text on raised (4.6:1). Not for sentences.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Light fill of illustrated objects: device screens, documents. Text on it uses on-tone.

tokens.name: on-tone
tokens.usage: Labels set on a category fill or on paper (at least 7:1 on every category).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Category 1, and the default accent: the current selection, focus ring, this-year values.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Category 2. Also 'good / saved / less' when a comparison needs a direction.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Category 3.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Category 4. The current moment in the Warm theme; 'more' in a two-way comparison when rose would read as an error.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Category 5. 'Used more / went up' in a comparison; never an error state on its own.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Category 6, for system or background parts (Applications, last year).

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Category 7, only when seven parts genuinely need telling apart.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one emphasis colour of an answer when categories are not needed: current point, active dot, filled scrubber span.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every focusable mark and control (≥3:1 on raised and canvas).

tokens.name: free-dot
tokens.usage: The dot texture of empty or free space (the only texture allowed). Never on a category fill.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number of an answer, rolled with RollingNumber. At most one per answer.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: The name or total of the selected subject (a place, a device, a total).

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Headline figure set inline with its unit in caption, e.g. '127 kWh less than last year'.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Altogether you've used 812 GB, 81% of your disk.
styles.usage: The one-sentence conclusion when the answer leads with words. Bold the figures in ink.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Name of a hovered or selected item in a readout.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Six months: 1,555 kWh against 1,682 last year.
styles.usage: Captions under the visual, in ink-soft with figures bold in ink. Two lines at most.

styles.name: ask
styles.usage: The user's question in the Ask bubble only.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Legend rows, working status, tile names.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Axis and mark labels, tooltip text. Tabular figures.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-label above a figure, at most one per view. Units beside small figures.

spacing.note: Steps come straight from the prototypes; they are not a 4px grid. Keep 5px and 7px gaps where they occur.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between capacity-bar segments; dot halo.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between area tiles (inset 2px each side).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control group (round buttons, legend dot to label).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between a working loader and its status text; legend column gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between legend items; between a figure and its caption.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between the question and the first line of the answer.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: AnswerPanel inset (sides and top); 20px at the bottom.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Page gutter around the panel in a full-page preview; 16px at phone width.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Capacity-bar segments, level lines, rails.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Tops of columns (bottom corners 3px).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Area tiles and illustrated phones at overview size.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Ask bubble.

tokens.name: radius-scene
tokens.usage: Outline of a containing scene (the disk room).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: AnswerPanel.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Every control, dot, knob, pill tooltip. Controls are circles or pills, never squares.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: A ring of the panel colour around knobs, playheads and timeline dots so they cut cleanly through lines and marks.

easing.note: CSS timing functions. Motion is a family the page does not draw; these are its values.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Rolling digits, control press and lift, dots growing on selection.

tokens.name: ease-morph
tokens.usage: Layout and shape morphs: tiles splitting, devices changing size, carousel moves.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Fades, text swaps, tooltip moves.

tokens.name: ease-draw
tokens.usage: Drawing a baseline, rail or axis in.

tokens.name: ease-travel
tokens.usage: Grains and forms travelling along an arc.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Hover emphasis and hover text. Hover never waits on another transition.

tokens.name: dur-swap
tokens.usage: SwapText out-and-in on state changes.

tokens.name: dur-state
tokens.usage: Reveal of a settled element, dimming of context.

tokens.name: dur-roll
tokens.usage: RollingNumber digit columns.

tokens.name: dur-morph
tokens.usage: Click-driven morphs: drill in, drill out, carousel step.

tokens.name: dur-travel
tokens.usage: One grain's arc; stagger 45ms between grains.
